apiNamedQueryParameters.description: The record Id of the Loan Application being assessed (Loan_Application__c.Id), taken from the current record the agent is launched on.

ApiNamedQuery.body2: SELECT Id, Name, Loan_Amount_Requested__c, Declared_Annual_Revenue__c, Verified_Annual_Revenue__c, Security_Type__c, Borrower_Type__c, Applicant__r.Name, Applicant__r.PersonBirthdate FROM Loan_Application__c WHERE Id = :loanApplicationId
ApiNamedQuery.description: Returns a loan application with its applicant's details — loan amount, declared vs verified revenue, security type, borrower type, and applicant name. Use to load the full profile for a loan assessment or credit memo.
